title: interop B4: live one-way run mimid -> mimi-hubd
description: Start mimi-hubd with throwaway certs, drive mimid PeerClient against its TLS-PL lane (keyMaterial, submitMessage, consent, identifierQuery, reportAbuse, update with one custom proposal). Manual runbook or ignored test; not in CI. Record mismatches as beads.
notes:
Haven builds root-level directory URLs as https://{provider_domain}{path} with no port (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs directory()). Locally the harness must make provider_domain resolve to the proxy/hub (e.g. provider_domain=localhost:<port> if Haven accepts a port there, or a hosts entry); mimid uses directory URLs as given (decision .6.48).
2026-11-02 live run (mimid e7db750, Haven d875bed = PR #4), harness /home/mark/Cache/mimid-haven-xcheck/live (README has rerun steps; driver/ crate; log b4-last-run.log):
1 directory: OK. mimid rustls (platform verifier) trusts SSL_CERT_FILE; Haven's partial directory parses (B1); groupInfo -> PeerError::NotOffered, nothing sent.
2 keyMaterial: 200, userStatus=Success, userUri=mimi://haven.localhost/u/bob, 1 client; KeyPackage (openmls 0.8.1 default lifetime, Haven-minted) verifies. First try with Haven test_helpers::key_package (Lifetime 0..u64::MAX) gave LifetimeTooLong: correct mimid behaviour (RFC 9420 §7.2, decision .7.25), test input only. Note: Haven returns the user URI as clientUri; protocol-06 L1259 does not constrain it, not filed.
3 submitMessage: 200, Accepted{frank: None}; Haven's stored message (GET /mimi/v1/message?user=<room>) byte-identical to the submitted appMessage.
4 update: 400 (PeerError::Rejected); carol not added (authorizeSender 403). Bare Commit via curl also 400; Haven decoder: UnknownValue(34). New: .46.1.14 (bare Commit body, no UpdateRoomResponse; §5.3 L1438-1443, L1490-1500), .46.1.15 (private proposal 0xF7A0 vs AppDataUpdate 0x0022, §9 L3063-3064; openmls 0.8.1 without extensions-draft cannot parse ext-10 §4.7 inline body). Wording root already in wg .37.3 / decision .4.16 (noted there).
5 notify: 201.
Not tested: consent, identifierQuery, reportAbuse (no PeerClient client in mimid); keyMaterial with a mimid KeyPackage (blocked by .46.1.13, Haven-side). Nothing committed or posted.
